leave_bereavement_days_007.answer: 2 days per event, up to 20 days per contract period
leave_bereavement_days_007.evidence: up to two (2) additional consecutive days per event. ... Such leaves shall be with pay and shall not be deducted from the teacher's sick leave; however, each teacher is limited to twenty (20) days per contract period.

leave_bereavement_relatives_008.answer: mother, father, sister, brother, children, spouse, significant other, parents of spouse, parents of significant other, parent/child position holders, or household members
leave_bereavement_relatives_008.evidence: teacher's mother, father, sister, brother, children, spouse, significant other, parents of spouse, or parents of significant other and anyone who has the position of parent or child, or any person who has been a member of the teacher's household immediately prior to the critical illness.
